item.title: UK economy grows 0.7% in third quarter, fastest in over two years
item.body: The Office for National Statistics reported that the economy grew by 0.7% in the third quarter, its fastest expansion in two and a half years, and by 0.2% month on month in September. Consumers and businesses remained resilient despite high oil and gas prices.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📊 UK economy grows 0.7% in third quarter, fastest in over two years

The Office for National Statistics reported that the economy grew by 0.7% in the third quarter, its fastest expansion in two and a half years, and by 0.2% month on month in September. Consumers and businesses remained resilient despite high oil and gas prices.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
